system.description: When you use the Lightning Burst Force Power, also compare the result of your Use the Force check to each target's Fortitude Defense. If your check result equals or exceeds both a target's Reflex Defense and its Fortitude Defense, you push the target 1 square away from you and knock the target Prone. This movement does not provoke Attacks of Opportunity.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Legacy Era Campaign Guide
